ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, it is known that $\angle AOE = \angle COD$, and the ray $OC$ bisects $\angle BOE$, $\angle EOD = 30^\circ$. What is the degree measure of $\angle AOD$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since $\angle AOB=180^\circ$ and $\angle EOD=30^\circ$,\\
it follows that $\angle AOD+\angle EOC+\angle COB=150^\circ$.\\
Since $\angle AOE=\angle COD$,\\
it follows that $\angle AOD=\angle EOC$.\\
Since $OC$ bisects $\angle EOB$,\\
it follows that $\angle EOC=\angle COB$,\\
hence $\angle EOC=\angle COB=\angle AOD=\boxed{50^\circ}$.
